items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: I'll tell you who used to play a good vowel trombone, Frankie Dewson... he couldn't compare with him... The Eagle band... That was Frankie Dewson band

ctx.x: Did he play valve or trombone?
No, it was slide Slide Yes, but I'll tell you who used to play a good vowel trombone, Frankie Dewson Yeah, Frankie Dewson used to play a good vowel trombone
Now how did he compare with Baptiste De Niel?
